status.en: 19 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 39% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 19 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 39 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Turkiye parliament ratified a defence agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, extending regional security cooperation. Israeli forces shelled sites in Syria’s Quneitra and struck targets in Syria and Lebanon, intensifying cross-border hostilities. Lebanese army fire killed a Syrian woman at the border, while Syrian intelligence dismantled ISIS cells in Aleppo and Manbij. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Det tyrkiske parlamentet ratifiserte en forsvarsavtale med Saudi-Arabia og Pakistan, og utvidet regionalt sikkerhetssamarbeid. Israelske styrker skjøt på steder i Syrias Quneitra og rammet mål i Syria og Libanon, og intensiverte grenseoverskridende fiendtligheter. Libanesisk hærskyting drepte en syrisk kvinne ved grensen, mens syrisk etterretning avviklet IS-celler i Aleppo og Manbij. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
